source_row.rationale: Denial is a defense mechanism in which a person refuses to acknowledge a painful, threatening, or overwhelming reality, often serving as an initial, temporary buffer against emotional shock following difficult news such as a serious diagnosis. While it can be a normal part of an initial coping process, the nurse should continue to monitor whether it evolves into a barrier to necessary care engagement over time.
source_row.source_detail: Recognition and Understanding of Denial in Response to Difficult News
